environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. Task role has no IAM permissions beyond ECR pull and CloudWatch Logs. The ALB target group has a response timeout of 5s. AWS WAF v2 WebACL is associated with the ALB with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 1 in COUNT mode for telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'app-layer-constraints' at priority 2 containing a single rule that uses a RegexPatternSet matching request query strings against pattern `(?i)(?:union[\s/\*]+(?:all[\s/\*]+)?select|select[\s/\*]+(?:[\w*,\s]+)?from[\s/\*]+|\b(?:information_schema|sqlite_master)\b|'\s*(?:or|and)\s*'?\d*'?\s*[=<>])` with action BLOCK and response code 403, (3) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 3 with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING overridden to COUNT. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and the SQLite database is mounted from an EFS volume with uid/gid 1000 (non-root). The task definition specifies a seccomp profile that denies ptrace and process_vm_readv syscalls.

config.load_balancer: ALB with WAF v2 WebACL association
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
